corrections.corrected_text: The spell Eloquence will appear in the Oracle Class Deck in December 2015, and we'll include it in the print-on-demand errata deck for Wrath when we create it. If you have Eloquence, you can replace the spell Glibness in the Base Set and the Character Add-On Deck with Eloquence and treat the starting deck lists in the rulebook as if they say Eloquence instead of Glibness. When not using Eloquence, just treat Glibness as having the Basic trait, just as printed, for Wrath of the Righteous only. If you use it in any other set, treat it as having the Elite trait instead.
corrections.issue: Glibness was Elite in every other set, but it's Basic here. Which should it be?
